// Run at commit c25a4413 (vault_storage 5.x), saved there as test/generate_v5_fixture_test.dart: flutter test --dart-define=FIXTURE_OUT=<dir> test/generate_v5_fixture_test.dart
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_secure_storage/flutter_secure_storage.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:hive_ce_flutter/hive_flutter.dart';
import 'package:mocktail/mocktail.dart';
import 'package:vault_storage/src/entities/box_config.dart';
import 'package:vault_storage/src/vault_storage_impl.dart';

import 'mocks.dart';

const _docs = '/tmp/vault_storage_fixture_5x/docs';
const _out = String.fromEnvironment('FIXTURE_OUT');

Uint8List _bytes(int length) =>
    Uint8List.fromList(List.generate(length, (index) => (index * 7 + 3) & 0xFF));

void main() {
  test('writes the 5.x fixture', () async {
    TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
    MocksHelper.registerFallbackValues();
    final docs = Directory(_docs);
    if (docs.existsSync()) docs.deleteSync(recursive: true);
    docs.createSync(recursive: true);
    TestDefaultBinaryMessengerBinding.instance.defaultBinaryMessenger.setMockMethodCallHandler(
      const MethodChannel('plugins.flutter.io/path_provider'),
      (call) async => call.method == 'getApplicationDocumentsDirectory' ? _docs : null,
    );

    final keys = <String, String?>{};
    final secureStorage = MockFlutterSecureStorage();
    when(() => secureStorage.read(key: any(named: 'key'))).thenAnswer(
      (invocation) async => keys[invocation.namedArguments[#key] as String],
    );
    when(
      () => secureStorage.write(key: any(named: 'key'), value: any(named: 'value')),
    ).thenAnswer((invocation) async {
      keys[invocation.namedArguments[#key] as String] =
          invocation.namedArguments[#value] as String?;
    });
    when(() => secureStorage.delete(key: any(named: 'key'))).thenAnswer((_) async {});

    final storage = VaultStorageImpl(
      secureStorage: secureStorage,
      storageDirectory: 'hive',
      customBoxes: const [
        BoxConfig(name: 'plain_box'),
        BoxConfig(name: 'encrypted_box', encrypted: true),
        BoxConfig(name: 'lazy_box', encrypted: true, lazy: true),
      ],
    );
    await storage.init();

    await storage.saveNormal(key: 'text', value: 'hello 5.x');
    await storage.saveNormal(key: 'count', value: 42);
    await storage.saveNormal(key: 'ratio', value: 3.5);
    await storage.saveNormal(key: 'flag', value: true);
    await storage.saveNormal(key: 'list', value: [1, 2, 3]);
    await storage.saveNormal(
      key: 'map',
      value: {
        'a': 1,
        'nested': {
          'b': [true, null],
        },
      },
    );
    await storage.saveNormal(key: 'long_text', value: 'x' * 1500);
    await storage.saveSecure(key: 'secret', value: 'secret-5x');
    await storage.saveSecure(key: 'pin', value: 1234);
    await storage.saveSecure(key: 'credentials', value: {'user': 'u', 'pass': 'p'});
    await storage.saveNormal(key: 'theme', value: 'dark', box: 'plain_box');
    await storage.saveSecure(
      key: 'token',
      value: {
        'id': 'tok-5x',
        'scopes': ['a', 'b'],
      },
      box: 'encrypted_box',
    );
    await storage.saveNormal(
      key: 'record',
      value: {
        'x': [1, 2],
      },
      box: 'lazy_box',
    );

    await storage.saveNormalFile(
      key: 'normal_small',
      fileBytes: _bytes(300),
      originalFileName: 'small.bin',
      metadata: {'owner': 'fixture'},
    );
    await storage.saveNormalFile(
      key: 'normal_big',
      fileBytes: _bytes(2107000),
      originalFileName: 'big.bin',
    );
    await storage.saveSecureFile(
      key: 'secure_small',
      fileBytes: _bytes(300),
      originalFileName: 'small.bin',
    );
    await storage.saveSecureFile(
      key: 'secure_big',
      fileBytes: _bytes(2107000),
      originalFileName: 'big.bin',
    );
    await storage.saveNormalFile(
      key: 'custom_file',
      fileBytes: _bytes(300),
      originalFileName: 'custom.bin',
      box: 'lazy_box',
    );

    await storage.dispose();
    await Hive.close();

    final out = Directory(_out);
    if (out.existsSync()) out.deleteSync(recursive: true);
    out.createSync(recursive: true);
    for (final entity in docs.listSync(recursive: true).whereType<File>()) {
      if (entity.path.endsWith('.lock')) continue;
      final target = File('${out.path}/docs${entity.path.substring(docs.path.length)}');
      target.parent.createSync(recursive: true);
      entity.copySync(target.path);
    }
    const fileKeyPrefix = 'file_key_';
    File('${out.path}/keys.json').writeAsStringSync(
      const JsonEncoder.withIndent('  ').convert({
        'master': keys['hive_encryption_key'],
        'files': {
          for (final entry in keys.entries)
            if (entry.key.startsWith(fileKeyPrefix))
              entry.key.substring(fileKeyPrefix.length): entry.value,
        },
      }),
    );
  });
}
